title: Manual Cleave Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the desired number of rows and columns for each plate (up to four 96‑well plates) and select the reagent to be added; the system will automatically determine liquid‑handling parameters.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required labware files with a .json extension.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py extension) to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).
